verdict_note: Strong GTM and growth foundation with relevant cross-functional skills, but lacks direct customer marketing, storytelling, and content creation experience that OpenAI specifically emphasizes.

breakdown.note: Manager-level experience confirmed (AGM, Senior PM roles); OpenAI role is Manager tier. Progression and P&L ownership align well.

EdTech-to-AI transition credible via GEO research and hands-on AI platform exposure. B2C SaaS background translates; enterprise B2B storytelling is new.

top_signal: Raunak's GEO research and direct exposure to frontier AI platforms (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity) combined with 8+ years of GTM strategy ownership and proven ability to translate complex product implementations into positioning and messaging make him a credible bridge from growth GTM into customer narrative strategy at an AI company.

His background is funnel optimization and GTM execution, not content/storytelling production. This is a meaningful pivot, not a lateral move.
